title: Very thin!
text: Very thin!. I bought this blanket, then received an email the next day from the seller warning me not to let a pet on this blanket. What? Why don't they have that in their advertisements? I returned it because my dog sleeps with me. I wasn't thrilled anyway as the blanket was very thin (the weight was very similar to my flannel sheets), you could see your hand through it.
